articles.summary: MIAMI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 16, 2026-- World Kinect Corporation (NYSE: WKC), operating as World Fuel, announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share, which is payable on October 16, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 28, 2026.
articles.title: World Kinect Corporation Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend
